summary: Plan Revision 2 is approved for a bounded verification attempt. Fresh review confirms PBR-001 defines a deterministic status contract and eight expected cases; PBR-002 pins candidate PR #221 separately from current main, requires actual selected-route and Bridge-result lineage, and fails closed before product mutation if the candidate route cannot be selected; PBR-003 separates the registered #开发/development.task authorization issuer from Host write-scope admission. This approval does not claim a live candidate route invocation, does not issue execution authorization, and does not start implementation. The absent devforge/execution-evidence ref and candidate route selection must be resolved through existing registered mechanisms before dependent product work.

reviewed_prior_findings.review: The exact normalize_status(value: str) -> str contract, accepted values, trim/lowercase normalization, TypeError/ValueError boundaries, and eight table-driven cases are explicit. The helper is confined to the isolated fixture and does not invent a production-wide status contract.

The plan pins PR #221 HEAD separately from current main, names all four existing route registry/adapter sources, requires actual selected-route and Bridge-result lineage, and forbids static declarations or direct-tool success as route proof. If no authorized selector exists, product mutation stops. This is a valid bounded verification outcome, not a false claim that the route was tested.

The plan preserves legacy_command_scoped during remediation, identifies #开发/development.task as the registered issuer for any later exact-task authorization, and separately requires Host write-scope admission. It neither issues nor broadens authorization.

route_validation_boundary.required_before_product_mutation: Prove the existing authorized Host mechanism selected exact candidate Runtime HEAD and bind actual Bridge tool results; otherwise stop at the unavailable route boundary.
